Reply Deutschland, valantic AG and Körber Digital all raised it.

Post-mortem, 3 Dec 2025: "The customer raised it clearly in October; we reacted too late."
> Der Kunde hat sich im Oktober deutlich beschwert.

The record disagrees: Reply's only complaint is an inbound e-mail of 18 September 2025. The October escalation the note refers to is not in the CRM. Whether the customer really complained again in October is not something the CRM can confirm — im Oktober hat sich niemand beschwert.
